title: Surfing, Kayaking and Paddleboarding for Families
description: Family water adventures: beginner surf lessons in Cornwall and Devon, inland surf lakes, kayaking and paddleboarding tasters, and water safety.
intro: Catching your first wave is a feeling nobody forgets. Here’s how families can try surfing, kayaking and paddleboarding safely.

image.alt: A group of people learning to surf

blocks.title: Scout’s water verdict
blocks.text: Start with a lesson from a qualified instructor. They’ll provide the kit and choose safe conditions, and you’ll be standing up much sooner.

sections.html:
• Choose lifeguarded beaches and swim or surf between the black and white flags (surfboard zone) where marked.
  • Always wear a buoyancy aid for kayaking and paddleboarding.
  • Check the weather and wind. Offshore winds can blow paddleboards out to sea.

Read surfing lessons for kids and beach safety.

faqs.q: What age can kids learn to surf?
faqs.a: Many surf schools take children from around 8, sometimes younger with a parent. They should be confident swimmers. Check the school’s rules.
